articles.title: The average S&P 500 company is spending less time in the index
articles.mainIdea: The average S&P 500 company is spending less time in the index
articles.summary: Yahoo Finance: The average S&P 500 company is spending less time in the index. This turnover means it’s incredibly difficult to not only know which stocks to own, but also when to own them. Related tickers mentioned: SPGI, ^GSPC.
